qualification: Historical release copy retained verbatim as data; not current feature, eligibility or catalogue-completeness guidance.

entries.title: 📅 Schedule outside-app trades
entries.desc: Schedule can now reserve regular, special, or remote trades with someone who is not on the app, so your daily counters stay accurate.

entries.title: 🤝 Trade match in Inventory
entries.desc: Trade Match now lives in Inventory → Browse community beside each trainer, where their posted inventory is already in context.

entries.title: 🤝 Trade match view
entries.desc: Trade Match shows what they have that you want, what you have that they want, and possible mirrors.

entries.title: Small reliability cleanup
entries.desc: Mobile username suggestions are more reliable, Health Check is clearer, and string import copy now explains the dex-only format without ringing the update bell.

entries.title: 🚫 Untradeable Mythicals out of the trade list
entries.desc: Mythicals that can't actually be traded in PoGo no longer appear in the trade dropdown. Meltan / Melmetal / Gimmighoul still do.

entries.title: 🎯 Sprite rework — size & alignment
entries.desc: Inventory and Browse sprites now scale and center cleanly even for small-bodied species like Cleffa, Igglybuff, Mime Jr.

entries.title: 🗑️ "Safe-to-transfer" search string
entries.desc: Strings tab → generate a PoGo bag-search string for every species nobody on your chosen trade-partner list wants. Auto-filters favorites, shinies, hundos, shadows, and events.

entries.title: ↩️ Cancelling a trade restores both inventories
entries.desc: When you ✗ cancel a reserved trade, your Pokémon return immediately. The other trainer's side restores on their next sync.

entries.title: 🎒 Inventory tab rename
entries.desc: The old Have tab is now Inventory. Keyboard shortcut works as both `i` and `h`. Posting a public offer also no longer silently fails when the browser blocks the clipboard.

entries.title: ⚖️ Clearer priority mismatches in Compare mode
entries.desc: Badges now label whose H/M/L is whose ("You H · AC53 M"). Matching priorities show a ✓.

entries.title: 📱 Cross-device "What's New" sync
entries.desc: Read the changelog on desktop, your phone won't re-prompt.

entries.title: 📵 "Edits not syncing" banner
entries.desc: When your sign-in quietly expires, an amber banner explains and offers one-tap re-sign-in.

entries.title: ⚡ Speed-add mode
entries.desc: My List toggle so priority and flags stay selected while you add a big batch of Pokémon.

entries.title: 🩺 Login health check
entries.desc: "Having trouble signing in?" link on the login screen runs diagnostics and tells you what's wrong.

entries.title: 🎯 Special Trade Board (image export)
entries.desc: Build a Looking-For / For-Trade board with shiny + mirror toggles, export as a clean image ready for Discord.

entries.title: 🌟 Every legendary + multi-form Pokémon
entries.desc: Mewtwo, Mew, all Ultra Beasts, Galar/Hisui/Paldea legendaries, and Paradox Pokémon. Multi-form Pokémon each get their own entry.

entries.title: ♂ ♀ Track Pokémon by gender
entries.desc: Keep separate ♂ / ♀ rows for species where gender matters (Heracross, Nidoran, etc.).

entries.title: ✨ Shiny flag, offline mode, shortcuts, welcome tour
entries.desc: New ✨ Shiny flag. App works offline once loaded. Press ? for keyboard shortcuts. New users get a quick tour.

entries.title: 🔓 Stay signed in
entries.desc: Sessions now last 30 days and refresh every time you use the app. No more re-entering your PIN every time you open the app.

entries.title: 🌙 New "Dark Cards" image export style
entries.desc: Image exports come in two styles now — Classic (light) and Dark Cards. Both have cleaner, more consistent sprite quality.

entries.title: ☑ Bulk inventory edits
entries.desc: Select multiple inventory entries to change their return mode, bump quantities, or delete in one go.

entries.title: 🤝 + 📤 Two new inventory modes
entries.desc: Mark items as "Fair trade" (comparable rarity from your wishlist) or "Giveaway" (take it off my hands for anything reasonable).

entries.title: 🎒 Mirror-only inventory
entries.desc: Mark items as "Mirror only" when you only want the exact same Pokémon back. Browse and offer screens show this clearly.

entries.title: 📅 Edit scheduled trades
entries.desc: You can now edit a scheduled trade after creating it — switch between Regular / Special / Remote, change date/time, etc.

entries.title: 📅 Trade Schedule tab
entries.desc: New Schedule tab with a week-view calendar. Plan trades with specific trainers, track your daily quota, and see live Pokémon GO events.

entries.title: 🔔 Public offers (first-come-first-served)
entries.desc: Offers on inventory items are now public, so you can see who offered what and when. The first offer gets a green "1st" badge so everyone respects FCFS.

entries.title: 🎒 Inventory ("Have" tab)
entries.desc: Track what Pokémon you have to trade. Others can browse your inventory and offer trades. ⭐ Auto-highlights items that match your wishlist.

entries.title: Updated Max lists
entries.desc: Dynamax list matches the current Pokémon GO roster, including Drilbur and Excadrill.

entries.title: Compare two trainers
entries.desc: Tap the scale icon in Strings to compare your list against another trainer. See what you both want, only you want, or only they want.

entries.title: Visual polish
entries.desc: Type colors, theme toggle, smoother animations, nicer empty states, "what's new" notifications.

entries.title: Export & share
entries.desc: Export your list as Markdown (Discord/Reddit) or CSV. Send a read-only share link to anyone.

entries.title: Mobile-first
entries.desc: Swipe to delete on My List. Pull to refresh. Cleaner mobile add form.

entries.title: Trainer profiles
entries.desc: Custom Pokémon avatars, bios, Discord handles. Diff view shows what changed in someone's list since you last looked.

entries.title: Bulk operations
entries.desc: Toggle bulk edit to select multiple entries and apply priority, flags, or delete in one go.

entries.title: Flags & filters
entries.desc: Independent ⚡ Lucky / XXL / XXS flags with their own search strings. Filter Browse by any combination.
